scope: Shared scalar validation requires DISCARD for nonzero multisampling and enforces the versioned lockable flag exception: D3D8 accepts the flag but refuses multisampled buffer locks; D3D9 rejects it. D3D9 quality indices outside the sole advertised level zero return INVALIDCALL at constructor/Reset/additional entry, including when multisampling is NONE. Reject before allocation/emission or caller-output changes; failed Reset retains the graph, reports DEVICENOTRESET and suppresses lost Presents until valid recovery. D3D8 texture_lock_level now refuses every nonzero multisample type before lock/readback state changes, including lockable targets. Native structural prefix tests stop before backend capability checks and do not claim D3D9 additional 4x MSAA support; that existing unsupported boundary is explicitly retained and checked in XP. The XP probe validates constructor/Reset 4x modes, D3D8 additional 4x and the versioned flags, eight lock refusals, invalid combinations/quality, exact cleanup and Reset recovery. No draw/readback/successful Present is captured and no new GPU pixel acceptance is claimed. Full refresh/window/fullscreen/MSAA validation, D3D9 additional MSAA, multiple-buffer storage/rotation, complete Reset/thread/device loss, original Microsoft HAL, game/FPS acceptance and review stages 4/5/6 remain incomplete. Host/protocol/shader/bundle unchanged; inherit the prior accepted GPU baselines.

sources.evidence: Pinned Windows test_multisample: D3D8 Reset permits LOCKABLE_BACKBUFFER with multisampling, but LockRect on the resulting buffer returns INVALIDCALL.
Pinned Windows test_multisample: D3D9 Reset rejects LOCKABLE_BACKBUFFER with multisampling and publishes DEVICENOTRESET.
Parameter conversion explicitly enables WINED3D_SWAPCHAIN_ALLOW_MS_LOCKABLE_BACKBUFFER for D3D8.
D3D9 parameter conversion does not enable the D3D8 multisample lockable-backbuffer exception.

documentation.evidence: Nonzero MultiSampleType requires DISCARD; quality is below the level count returned by CheckDeviceMultiSampleType, otherwise INVALIDCALL. This backend advertises one level.
